title: Paint Splash
tagline: Roll giant paint rollers with up to 4 friends and paint a picture together!
howToPlay: Drag anywhere (or use the arrow keys) to roll your animal's paint roller and colour the ground. Grab a 🪣 paint bucket for a big splash, roll through a 🌈 rainbow puddle to paint rainbow stripes, and 💧 water washes a little paint away. Roll over any colour to make it yours. When the time is up, look at the picture you made together!
